newText: The Guild regularly and securely hosts many firms researching cases that are tried at the Superior Court, which is less than a five-minute walk away. The court is part of the California trial court system, the largest of its kind in the world, and San Diego is the second largest court system in the state, after Los Angeles. The court’s activities are held in the 71 courtrooms of the San Diego Central Courthouse, which see criminal, civil, probate, family law, and small claims cases.
